study.question: Does preserving field correspondence in target-conditioned retrieval, and letting category and brand select different supplied events, improve over early-added history embeddings without extra parameters? Observation: baseline-static/pooled/din AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. The incumbent r0002-support_pair reaches 0.6184566652. All r0003 summary additions are lower (global_mean 0.6178996264, global_attention 0.6178267412, action_mean 0.6178636332, action_attention 0.6179337371), despite 8192 added dense parameters. Their sampled diagnostics establish that rare-action summaries exist, not that those summaries help. All these branches retain early-added category+brand+action+age vectors in the scorer. Source inspection identifies that untested representational restriction; the outcomes do not diagnose it causally.
study.hypothesis: PROSPECTIVE, not controlled support: category and brand may need different target-conditioned history routes. Adding fields before the nonlinear scorer forces a common event weighting and permits mixed-field correlations; partitioning by action does not remove that restriction. A single shared nonlinear scorer applied to separate field query/value pairs, followed by separate masked softmaxes and a D-dimensional sum, may preserve useful complementary evidence. Predict stronger separate-routing benefit with aligned than crossed query fields. This is a new local mechanism contrast, not a verified new architecture in the literature, and no matrix-rank theorem from self-attention is asserted for this single-query MLP scorer.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.06978v4 ; DIN sec.4.3 Eq.3, Fig.2, pp.4-5; inspected 2026-11-04
nearest_work.difference: Inherit candidate-aware nonlinear activation, shared field embeddings and MLP readout. Original DIN concatenates goods attributes and abandons softmax normalization; the local reference early-adds category/brand/action/time and normalizes. This study retains normalized attention and explicit statistics, uses two tied scorer calls and tests field correspondence by normalization with swapped-query controls. It is not an exact DIN reproduction.

DIF-SR separates attribute/item self-attention scores, fuses them before softmax, updates item-ID values, and adds attribute-prediction supervision. Here there is no historical item ID, self-attention stack or auxiliary loss. A shared DIN-style scorer performs two target-to-history field comparisons; separate softmaxes route respective field values and sum into the same D coordinates. Shared averaged-score routing is the closest late-score-fusion control. Fieldwise attention is existing work; this factorial local adaptation and its negative branches are the contribution under test, with global novelty unverified.

Retain all parameter constructors, static features and deterministic evidence. Replace only early-added-field history retrieval. Parent-versus-cell performance includes the common switch to two shared scorer calls and half-context values; it cannot isolate separate routing or correspondence.

That failed branch appends four action-conditioned D-vectors while retaining the original global pool. This study replaces the global pool, partitions retrieval by field rather than action, ties scorer parameters, and preserves D width and parent parameter count.

study.proposed_difference: Define vc=Ecat(history_category)+0.5*(Eaction+Eage) and vb=Ebrand(history_brand)+0.5*(Eaction+Eage); their sum equals the original event value. Use the same inherited scorer a(q,v)=MLP([q,v,q-v,q*v]) for both fields. Aligned: sc=a(target_cat,vc), sb=a(target_brand,vb). Crossed: sc=a(target_brand,vc), sb=a(target_cat,vb), with no value/order swap. Shared: w=masked_softmax((sc+sb)/2), pool=sum_j w_j*(vc_j+vb_j). Separate: wc=masked_softmax(sc), wb=masked_softmax(sb), pool=sum_j wc_j*vc_j+sum_j wb_j*vb_j. Both alternatives are computed in every cell. Every head uses the same supplied mask; missing ID zero never creates a new equality match and embeds as zero, while action/age context remains. All-padding rows yield exactly zero. Use dtype-min masked scores and post-mask renormalization. Forward returns finite-shape [B] logits subject to host tensor verification; no optimizer or loss override, I/O, data-dependent parameter initialization, or extra supervision. Four standalone modules differ only in literal CONFIG.
predictions: Primary planned contrast: aligned_separate versus aligned_shared AUC difference is positive; use +0.0002 AUC as a prospective practical screening margin, not a significance threshold. Parent r0002-support_pair remains the performance benchmark and is selected if no candidate improves on it.

Semantic attribution contrast: aligned_separate exceeds crossed_separate. Factorial interaction I=(AUC(aligned_separate)-AUC(aligned_shared))-(AUC(crossed_separate)-AUC(crossed_shared)) should be positive if correct field correspondence specifically enables the routing benefit. Report both simple effects even if interaction is negative.

Candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics may show distinct field weight distributions and separate-versus-shared pooled vectors. These establish that the implementation has opportunity to differ, not a mechanism-performance connection or causal field importance. Empty/padding diagnostics should be zero within numerical tolerance.

Use host full-population validation AUC, unweighted Logloss and available slice counts/positives/negatives. Predeclare exploratory checks for category_match_present/absent, history-length bins, and user training-frequency bins; all inherited slice counts apply. Do not derive bins from validation or infer significance from slice fluctuations.

All four cells have expected parent parameter counts. Measure wall/train time, allocated GPU time if supplied, inference throughput/p50/p95 and peak memory; two scorer calls likely cost more than the parent. Same-epoch isolation is not an equal-compute efficiency claim.
falsifiers: If aligned_separate does not improve over aligned_shared, this implementation gives no support for separate field routing, even if all cells improve over the early-fused parent.

If crossed_separate is as good as aligned_separate or the interaction is nonpositive, do not attribute any gain to correct field correspondence. A crossed control can adapt during training, so this does not refute all semantic-routing mechanisms.

If all cells fail to improve incumbent primary AUC, retain the incumbent and record the entire round as unsuccessful for model selection; modest secondary-metric gains cannot reverse the frozen primary criterion.

If weights collapse to identical distributions, semantic-support/missing-field opportunities are insufficient, or the candidate fails/caps out, distinguish implementation failure, insufficient discriminating data, and negative predictive evidence. Do not count a runtime failure as scientific refutation.

A screening gain that disappears across paired seeds 42/43/44 or a paired user-cluster bootstrap, when available from the authorized host, remains preliminary or unsupported. No independent-impression significance claim is permitted.
alternative_explanations: All cells replace early fusion with tied late nonlinear scoring; a common improvement could be from gradient conditioning or removal of early cross terms, not independent routing.

Averaging two scores before softmax may have different entropy from applying two separate softmaxes. Norm/sharpness and optimization effects may explain a separate-routing gain; an entropy/temperature-matched follow-up would be needed if consequential.
Same parameters do not imply equal effective capacity, gradient alignment, cost or statistical regularization. Branch selection changes backward work; measure cost.

Learned category and brand spaces can align under crossed queries, reducing the strength of that control. Direct target-match statistics remain in all cells and may make learned field routing redundant.

Single-seed differences, repeated validation selection, best-checkpoint variation, static snapshot ambiguities, coarse hashed/encoded fields, sparse rare actions and the 128-event truncation may dominate the effect. No population or production transfer claim.
The code has been checked structurally and with independent scalar formulas only. Torch, private data, gradients, peak memory and host execution remain unverified until the automatic host receipt.
